scope: Bindings v3: physical native PPTX table text slots and plain insertion in an existing empty paragraph, with source package and merge topology retained

implementation.physical_identity: Formats-owned cell properties opendoc_formats.pptx_cell preserve original physical row/column; not a substitute for complete logical-table normalization
implementation.topology: Validate rectangular physical grid, positive bounded origin spans, nonoverlapping coverage and exact hMerge/vMerge ownership; continuation slots cannot be edited as origins
implementation.text: Native a:r/a:t binds to existing Model Paragraph runs; original breaks and empty middle paragraphs remain structural, links/styles unchanged
implementation.empty_slot: One plain TextRun may fill an empty paragraph with no new style/link/properties; copy native endParaRPr caret formatting to new rPr, retaining original end marker; linked caret defaults remain outside profile
implementation.freshness: Mask only proved cell text or plain empty-slot insertion in official Model codec digest; rows/cells/spans/style changes remain protected
implementation.compatibility: v1/v2 snapshots retain their former scope; v3 captures new cells without reinterpreting old snapshots
implementation.shared_dom: Cell text, shape text and geometry modify one bounded source DOM; no projection overwrites another
implementation.publication: Cancellation checked before each cell mutation; old destination and input Model retained on refusal/cancellation

checks.regression_command: python -m pytest tests/readers tests/writers tests/support/test_ooxml_pptx_package.py tests/support/test_ooxml_package.py -k 'pptx or office_export_cancellation or ooxml_package' -q --tb=short
checks.large_pptx_scope: Own 35-slide/6720-run fixture, selected budgets, public JSON, inspection/export and unchanged source
checks.retention: Two JSON/PPTX cycles, all unchanged ZIP file payload bytes, tblGrid/row heights/merge attributes/tcPr, link and run formatting, unknown inert ZIP neighbor, simultaneous table translation
checks.negative: Continuation edit, row/cell reorder, changed spans/fill/new insertion style, unsupported new control characters, incomplete/unknown/overflow merge topology; no guessed bindings
checks.source_integrity: Original input bytes and input Model JSON unchanged

installed_wheel.profile: pptx only; fontTools, DOCX/PDF engines and bs4 absent
installed_wheel.result: passed: native shape text and Box plus existing cell edit and empty-cell insertion; only source slide XML changes

independent_powerpoint.procedure: Native TextRange replaces merged origin and styled first run and fills empty cell; export native reference and library PPTX separately to PDF with macros disabled and read-only original
independent_powerpoint.equality_policy: Native vs Formats within each renderer; no equality asserted between different renderer implementations
